objective: Build the real owner experience: a Command Center that shows goals, projects, missions, candidate decisions, rejected alternatives, current workers, verification, findings, releases, capabilities, costs, resources, evidence, health, incidents, waiting/blockers, and next autonomous actions; evidence drill-down and a durable decision/effect timeline; owner controls STOP/VETO/PAUSE/RESUME/REPRIORITIZE/REDIRECT operating through the SAME canonical durable directive system (the UI is not authority; voice is not authority; Hermes is not authority; failure of any of them cannot remove Supervisor control). Briefings distinguish FACT / UNCERTAINTY / RECOMMENDATION / ACTION / COST / MISSING_EVIDENCE. Prove real English interaction, real Albanian interaction, and voice against a real configured provider/interface when available (mock STT/TTS is never real voice proof). Visually inspect the actual UI and test responsive layout, accessibility, empty state, stale state, degraded state, provider failure, restart, reconciliation, and STOP during UI failure.

governed_proving_area.purpose: The Command Center renders from REAL durable kernel/ledger state produced by the remaster gates (R7 portfolio/missions, R8 orchestration missions, R9 capabilities) read from isolated proving stores; owner directive controls mutate ONLY the isolated proving directive store, never live Supervisor state.
governed_proving_area.privacy_boundary: Evidence records identities, hashes, timestamps, provenance, and non-sensitive excerpts only; no credentials/secrets in UI or evidence.
governed_proving_area.voice: REAL configured provider/interface ONLY if available in this environment (e.g., Windows SAPI / local speech interface); otherwise honestly NOT_TESTED; mock STT/TTS is never real voice proof.

mandatory_deliverables.detail: A real usable web UI (served locally) showing: goals, projects, missions, candidate decisions, rejected alternatives, current workers, verification, findings, releases, capabilities, costs, resources, evidence, health, incidents, waiting/blockers, next autonomous actions; evidence drill-down and a durable decision/effect timeline. Visually inspected (screenshots), responsive, accessible, with empty/stale/degraded/provider-failure states.

Owner controls STOP / VETO / PAUSE / RESUME / REPRIORITIZE / REDIRECT operate through the same canonical durable directive system (ledger events + portfolio ControlState), NOT through UI-local state; the UI merely renders and submits; a UI failure cannot remove Supervisor control; STOP during UI failure proven.

Briefings distinguish FACT / UNCERTAINTY / RECOMMENDATION / ACTION / COST / MISSING_EVIDENCE and are generated from durable state with evidence references; at least one English and one Albanian briefing proven.

Real interaction in both languages: the Command Center and briefing endpoints accept English and Albanian and return correct language output (not machine-translated mock); proven with real fixtures and tests.
If a real configured voice interface is available, prove real STT/TTS with receipts; otherwise record NOT_TESTED with a real interface probe. Mock STT/TTS is never presented as real voice proof.
Evidence records for the UI (screenshots, DOM/accessibility checks, state transitions), the directive system, briefings, languages, and voice status; exact next autonomous action.

Briefings distinguish FACT/UNCERTAINTY/RECOMMENDATION/ACTION/COST/MISSING_EVIDENCE; at least one English and one Albanian briefing proven from durable state.
Real English and Albanian interaction proven; language correctness verified, not mock.
Voice: real provider proof if available, otherwise honest NOT_TESTED with real interface probe; mock never presented as real.
Responsive layout, accessibility, empty/stale/degraded/provider-failure states, restart, reconciliation tested; full repo suite green; static clean; no protected mutation; evidence under 8 MiB.
